task_description: Build a greenfield MLB postseason information summary site for the Kiro University final exam: a React+TS (Vite) SPA that graphically shows postseason status (bracket/series/standings) with a win/loss prediction feature powered by Amazon Bedrock narratives. Backend is API Gateway + Lambda (TS) with DynamoDB caching of MLB Stats API data (seed fallback). AWS CDK (TS) provides one-command deploy. Includes Kiro steering files plus artifacts demonstrating all 7 required Kiro University lessons + 2 bonuses (specs, hooks, MCP, custom agent, property-based tests, packaged power, cloud writeup) and a judge-facing DEMONSTRATED_LESSONS.md, a Playwright e2e suite, and a tracked ISSUES.md. Deliverable is complete, buildable, synth-verified code; no live cdk deploy (AWS creds inactive this session).

verification.summary: Final clean verification: `npm run build` (shared->backend->frontend->infra) exit 0; `npm test` = 49 unit tests pass (backend 31 incl. fast-check property tests, frontend 12, infra 6); `npm run test:e2e -w frontend` = 7 Playwright specs pass (headless chromium --no-sandbox); `npm run synth` (cdk synth) exits 0 producing MlbPostseasonStack.template.json (DynamoDB TTL table, 2 Node 20 Lambdas, HTTP API routes + CORS, CloudFront + OAC + SPA error responses, private S3, bedrock:InvokeModel IAM, single BucketDeployment SPA + /config.js, CfnOutputs ApiUrl/DistributionDomainName/BucketName/TableName). All 6 .kiro JSON artifacts (3 hooks, mcp.json, custom agent, power manifest) parse as valid JSON; every path referenced by DEMONSTRATED_LESSONS.md resolves. No live AWS/Bedrock/MCP/cdk deploy calls (creds inactive this session, by design). Test quality verified by reading tests (unit + property-based + infra assertions + e2e all exercise real code paths). No Dockerfile; docker_build skipped.
